svg.title: Orders of magnitude from a proton to the universe
svg.desc: A marker sweeps a logarithmic length axis from 10 to the minus 15 meters to 10 to the 26 meters, passing a proton, an atom, a virus, a cell, a person, Earth, the Earth–Moon and Earth–Sun distances, a light-year, the Milky Way and the observable universe. Animated motion has a static alternative for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Logarithmic scale: each tick is ten times the last. Sizes and distances are orders of magnitude, from
a proton to the observable universe.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
